text.line: Hi there, I’m Luna! Welcome to Day 1 of our learning adventure.
Today we’ll count together, rhyme, and meet some friendly animals.
Don’t worry, I’ll guide you every step of the way.
Just relax, take a deep breath, and get ready for some fun!
When you’re ready, tap Next to begin.
Let’s make today awesome—you’re a superstar!
Let’s take a fun breathing break with Momo!
Ready? Sit up straight and put your hand on your tummy.
One more time: in… hold… out…
Feel how calm you are? Great job!

text: Six, seven, eight, nine, ten! You did it!
Let’s play ‘Guess That Animal’ with Momo!
I’m small, I hop, and I love to eat carrots. Who am I?
That’s right, I’m a rabbit! Great guessing!
Benny the dog runs in the fog.
He jumps over a log, and greets a friendly frog!
Time for a story with Luna!
Luna and her friends went on a treasure hunt.
At the end, they found a sparkling sticker just for you!
See you tomorrow for more fun adventures!
